Tool Aggregation System · skills + MCP + tools
Tap a pack to pin it into the input box — the agent must use that system to finish your task.
Aggregate packs of skills, MCP servers, tools and an agent workflow — pick one and its whole system agent goes live.
Activation installs the pack\'s skills, connects its MCP servers and injects its workflow. Bundled packs are preinstalled and cannot be uninstalled.
